text_blocks.snippet: Common side effects of Losartan include dizziness, upper respiratory infections, stuffy nose, back pain, fatigue, and diarrhea.
snippet_highlighted_words: dizziness, upper respiratory infections, stuffy nose, back pain, fatigue, and diarrhea

text_blocks.snippet: According to medical resources like the NHS and MedlinePlus, side effects are generally categorized into mild and serious categories.

list.snippet: Dizziness or lightheadedness: Most frequent when first starting the medication or raising the dose, as your body adjusts to lower blood pressure.
Cold-like symptoms: Stuffy nose, sinus discomfort, or upper respiratory infections.
Aches and pains: Back pain, leg pain, or muscle cramps.
Digestive changes: Mild nausea, vomiting, or diarrhea.
Fatigue or weakness: Feeling more tired than usual while the body adapts.
Angioedema: A dangerous allergic reaction causing swelling of the face, lips, tongue, or throat, and trouble breathing.
High potassium (hyperkalemia): Can cause muscle weakness, numbness, or an irregular heartbeat.
Low blood pressure (hypotension): Severe dizziness, confusion, fainting, or blurred vision.
Kidney problems: Decreased urination or swelling in the hands, ankles, and feet.
Fetal toxicity: Losartan can cause severe harm or birth defects to an unborn baby and must be stopped immediately if pregnancy is detected.
